items.title: Amid contract decisions, the Suns have maintained continuity from last season's surprise playoff team by signing Brooks, Collin Gillespie, Mark Williams and Jordan Goodwin to multiyear deals -- along with acquiring Miles Bridges and Luke Kennard.
items.author: Shams Charania Tweets
items.body_excerpt: Amid contract decisions, the Suns have maintained continuity from last season's surprise playoff team by signing Brooks, Collin Gillespie, Mark Williams and Jordan Goodwin to multiyear deals -- along with acquiring Miles Bridges and Luke Kennard.
